latest_final: Kameda, a king, prevailed in a political and ideological struggle against Umio. Umio was assassinated by agents acting for Kameda’s faction, and the victorious authorities deliberately denied him customary funeral rites before burying him. Kameda’s remains, by contrast, were fragmented through ordinary cremation after his death. Thus the fragments did not signify Kameda’s defeat; people read Umio’s burial without customary rites as a mark of his defeat, despite his body remaining intact.
